message: The other night, I realized our smoke alarm was chirping—nothing like a late-night reminder to check it! Instead of grumbling, I turned it into a little family event. We made some popcorn, gathered around, and took turns checking all the alarms in the house. It felt good to make sure we were prepared, and honestly, we laughed a lot. Who knew fire safety could be a cozy bonding moment? What’s your favorite way to turn chores into fun?
